item.title: A New Era in Banking Begins as Bank78 MFB - Nigeria’s First Fully Private Digital Bank, Launches
item.description: Dubbed Nigeria’s first fully private digital bank, Bank78 MFB is set to be Nigeria’s new prestigious digital bank, inspired by the private-banking culture.

item.title: Google to invest $2.1 million towards building AI talent in Nigeria
item.description: Google has announced a ₦3bn fund to support AI upskilling and digital safety programmes in Nigeria, backing groups like FATE Foundation and CyberSafe Foundation as the country pushes to operationalise its National AI Strategy.

item.title: The silent migration: What happens after talented Nigerians leave?
item.description: While the departure of skilled professionals continues to reshape Nigeria’s workforce, the story is not one of loss alone.

item.title: How this Nigerian lady turned her experience at NITDA and Interswitch into a product company
item.description: In this edition of After Hours, we follow Unyime Tommy, founder of Assurdly, a product delivery company. She shares her journey from NITDA to Interswitch and now building her own startup.

item.title: Google to register in Uganda after dropping court battle
item.description: On Techpoint Digest, we discuss Google dropping a court battle as Uganda demands compliance, how Interswitch shaped one founder's tech DNA, and Tanzania's phone-tap payments via M-Pesa.

item.title: Why photographers don't care when you use AI for your birthday shoot
item.description: Photographers in Nigeria are seeing AI reshape parts of their industry. From birthday portraits to stock images, some embrace it, others worry about lost work.

item.title: UK's Wise gets approval to operate in South Africa
item.description: On Techpoint Digest, we discuss UK-based Wise bagging its first African licence, what photographers think about AI photoshoots, and Canal+ resetting MultiChoice’s cost base.

item.title: NITDA trains 3,600 teachers to drive nationwide digital literacy push
item.description: NITDA has trained 3,600 teachers nationwide to boost digital literacy, equipping them as master-trainers for schools. The initiative expands Nigeria’s push to build a tech-ready workforce amid rising AI and digital-skills programmes across the country.

item.title: Schneider Electric Announces New AI Infrastructure Framework to Support Nigeria’s Growing Digital Economy
item.description: Artificial intelligence is reshaping global competitiveness, and Nigeria is no exception.
